title: Optimize AMD Settings
name: optimize-amd-settings
modal: This disables ULPS, enables MSI mode and disables fullscreen optimizations. You can revert it here or in the AMD Adrenalin control panel.
deepDescription:
This changes AMD graphics settings for better gaming performance:

- Ultra Low Power State (ULPS) → Off
- MSI mode for the AMD GPU → On
- Fullscreen optimizations → Off
description: Changes AMD Radeon Control Panel settings to improve gaming performance
